readings: For each order, count its invoices and work out its share of all invoices (its count divided by the total). For the orders whose share is strictly above the average share, give one unrounded row with: their total number of invoices, their average share, and the average amount by which their share exceeds the average share.
queries:
WITH invoice_counts AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count
    FROM Orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_count,
        1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM invoice_counts
),
compared AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess
FROM compared
WHERE share > overall_average_share
